title: The future of prompt engineering: where the field is heading
body:
A few directions worth watching (treat these as informed trends, not certainties):

  • Less reliance on "tricks" — as models get better, some workarounds may become less necessary for simpler tasks, though they'll remain valuable for hard problems.
  • Growth of agentic systems — more workflows will involve AI that takes multi-step autonomous action, shifting the skill toward "designing the system and guardrails around an agent."
  • Native multi-modality — text, image, audio, and video are increasingly treated as one combined input space.
  • Standardized evaluation — rigorous testing is becoming as core a skill as writing the prompt itself.

The constant underneath all of this: clear thinking, specificity, and structured communication will keep mattering, even as the exact techniques evolve.
